entry.title: Painlevé representations for joint moments of characteristic polynomials from the orthogonal and unitary symplectic groups
entry.summary:
We study joint moments of characteristic polynomials and their second derivatives for Haar-distributed matrices from the unitary symplectic and orthogonal groups. We establish their large-$N$ asymptotics throughout the full admissible range of the moment parameters and identify the limiting coefficients probabilistically in terms of the first inverse power sum of the Bessel point process. This extends the corresponding results of Assiotis, Gunes, Keating, and Wei [Proc.

entry.title: One-Step Schnorr Threshold Identification
entry.summary:
Threshold cryptographic primitives have not been widely adopted in real-world distributed systems (i.e., beyond the closed committee model) presumably due to state-synchronization overhead and complex certification processes for the shareholders. These are both aspects of their overreliance on infrastructure, an assumption that is usually glossed over in their design. In this work, we propose OSST, a real-time threshold identification protocol that achieves non-interactivity and non-reliance on public shares by means of direct proof interpolation.
